title.narrative: Emergency response to ensure access to a safe and inclusive educational environment in Yemen

description.narrative: 1- Expansion of 10 education schools by adding and equipping 28 classrooms. 2- Rehabilitating and equipping 10 schools that ensure the promotion of a comprehensive educational environment. 3- Improving the efficiency of the educational environment by distributing teaching aids and tools to male and female teachers. 4- Improving the psychological and recreational climate in the academic community by providing psychological and educational support activities for male and female students, in addition to implementing a training of trainers course for 40 school activities supervisors and social workers in the targeted schools and the training team in the education offices in the governorates in psychological support in emergencies

Rehabilitation and equipment of schools that ensure the promotion of a comprehensive educational environment and work to improve the efficiency of the educational environment through the distribution of educational means and tools for male and female teachers and improve the psychological and recreational climate in the academic community by providing psychological and educational support activities for students.

The project aims to provide a safe and appropriate educational environment for 20 targeted schools in nine districts located in four governorates in the most affected areas and among the most vulnerable groups. More than 16,000 male and female students and educational staff will benefit from it. Violence resulting from dropping out of school.
